summary: Great Indian Bustard conservation vs renewable energy infrastructure; balancing environmental protection with energy transition; overhead power lines causing habitat disruption; underground cabling feasibility challenged; bird diverters mandated; modification of 2021 order sought due to climate commitments; Court-appointed committee for site-specific assessment; feasibility of underground high-voltage lines disputed; international climate obligations considered; final decision requires balancing extinction risks against national energy goals.
final_judgment: Modification of previous order permitted subject to scientific assessment; underground cabling ordered where feasible; bird diverters implementation mandated; case returned to committee for site-specific evaluation balancing conservation and energy needs.
